contract.input: Combined active-low byte at control +14; U D L R B C A Start bits 0..7 in the observed three-button producer.
contract.output: FF/00 directions +1A..1D; A/B/C/Start +1E..21; +15 any A/B/C, +16 B/C, +17 A. Opposing axes normalize to zero.
contract.retained: Raw +14, +18/+19, every other control byte and D1..A6; D0/CCR scratch. No previous input or edge detection.
contract.not_implemented: Physical device I/O at 14DA2, alternative remapper 14E3C, pause, multiplayer/world scheduling.
